mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_message (message_id, request_message_id, session_id, user_id, eid, role, agent_code, status, content, cards_json, token_usage, completed_time) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{requestMessageId}, #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{eid}, #{role}, #{agentCode}, #{status}, #{content}, #{cardsJson}, #{tokenUsage}, #{completedTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_ai_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_message SET status = #{status}, content = #{content}, cards_json = #{cardsJson}, token_usage = #{tokenUsage}, completed_time = NOW() WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
UPDATE t_ai_message SET user_id = #{userId} WHERE eid = #{eid} AND user_id IS NULL
